run_skill_runner_interactive: run the skill_runner tool to execute Navigate, Open, Close, Pick, and Place skills in a Habitat environment
run_skill_runner_scripted: run the skill_runner tool with scripted commands via the skill_runner_scripted_commands config option
run_skill_runner_episode: run the skill_runner tool on a specific episode by index or id using CLI overrides
run_skill_runner_video: run the skill_runner tool and generate cumulative videos of all skill command executions
run_skill_runner_debug: run the skill_runner tool and enter a pdb breakpoint for interactive debugging with the debug command
